description: Fun with certificates - we've all been there, right? In this - perhaps brief - blog post, I'll explain how to automate the whole process and use Let's Encrypt. Since this post contains a lot of code, I've decided to publish it all in my public GitHub repo.
title: VCF 9.1 - C.E.R.B.E.R.U.S.: A Let's Encrypt Automation Pipeline
